prereg.stable_rule: composite: Gaussian stable iff max-over-5-attrs rel_change <= TAU
prereg.gate_B_rule: stable subset: exists p in {fp16,bf16} s.t. median p attr rep-error <= TAU AND median p optimizer-state moment rep-error <= TAU (all attrs/groups)
prereg.gate_C_rule: stable_fraction >= ECON_FRAC_MIN (>=20% mem reduction) AND stable_count >= ECON_COUNT_MIN

gateB_error.rule: stable subset: exists p in {fp16,bf16} s.t. median bf16 attr rep-error <= 0.01 AND median bf16 optimizer-state moment rep-error <= 0.01 (all attrs/groups)
